claims.text: On 12 January 2026 Fudan launched the AI3A education co-creation platform and published the Generative AI Education and Teaching Application Guide 1.0, with 11 annexes such as an AI use declaration template and reference syllabus clauses. According to Fudan's official announcement, the guide allows AI for supporting steps such as language polishing and structural suggestions but not to replace core academic work such as research conception, theory building and data analysis, and judges integrity mainly on honest disclosure and process records. The guide's full text sits on the AI3A platform and was not independently reviewed; it is teaching guidance and does not by itself override the stricter undergraduate-thesis rule.

topics.summary: 涉及保密内容的本科毕业论文禁止使用任何 AI 工具，禁止向 AI 平台上传任何数据和图片。所审核来源中未发现更广泛的全校 AI 数据规则；AI 办事大厅称采用本地化部署模型保护数据（未经独立核实）。

claims.text: The same Fudan undergraduate-thesis rule (Article 4) prohibits AI in six areas: research design and data analysis; generating or altering original data (unless AI itself is the research topic); generating or altering original result images and key illustrations (unless a reproducible AI method is part of the design and explained in the methods); directly generating thesis text or acknowledgements, including AI language polishing and translation; use of AI by defence committee members or reviewers to evaluate the thesis; and any AI use or upload for theses involving confidential content.

additionalTopics.title: 学术诚信与纪律程序
additionalTopics.summary: 本科毕业论文中，AI 仅可在征得指导教师同意后辅助文献检索、图表类型推荐、非创新性代码和参考文献格式整理，禁止用于研究设计、数据、关键图表、正文撰写、语言润色和翻译。违规视情节处理，从计入论文成绩、不准答辩，到构成学术不端时才给予纪律处分和学位处理。纪律处分可在 10 日内向学校学生申诉处理委员会申诉，对复查决定不服可在 15 日内向上海市教委申诉。
additionalTopics.scope: 论文规定第三、四、七条与申诉条例。

claims.text: Fudan's formal rule on AI tools in undergraduate theses (adopted by the Academic Affairs Office on 24 September 2024, trial) allows AI use only with the supervisor's consent and only where AI output does not affect assessment of the student's own innovative ability, in four areas: literature search and management (verifying references), suggesting chart types and auxiliary charting (not generating or altering original data or key research figures), coding and method screening where the method is not the thesis's innovation (all code and methods must be reviewed and tested by the author), and reference formatting (with checking). This rule is specific to undergraduate theses; it is not a rule for all courses or for graduate theses.

claims.text: The same Fudan undergraduate-thesis rule (Article 4) prohibits AI in six areas: research design and data analysis; generating or altering original data (unless AI itself is the research topic); generating or altering original result images and key illustrations (unless a reproducible AI method is part of the design and explained in the methods); directly generating thesis text or acknowledgements, including AI language polishing and translation; use of AI by defence committee members or reviewers to evaluate the thesis; and any AI use or upload for theses involving confidential content.

claims.text: Under the Fudan undergraduate-thesis AI rule, breaches are handled according to their seriousness: they may be reflected in the thesis assessment grade, lead to refusal of the defence or cancellation of a passing grade, and only where they constitute academic misconduct lead to disciplinary sanctions, loss of degree eligibility or degree revocation. Course papers, term papers and exam papers may refer to this rule where no specific rule exists, while published academic papers and research activities are governed by other rules and are outside its scope. Supervisors and reviewers may add supplementary assessment to check the student's mastery.

claims.text: Under Fudan's Student Disciplinary Regulations (2017, amended 2019), students must be informed of their right to state their case and defend themselves before a sanction. A student who disagrees with a disciplinary decision may appeal to the University Student Appeals Committee within ten days (not working days) of service of the decision; the committee normally concludes within fifteen days (extendable by fifteen), and a student who disagrees with the review decision may appeal to the Shanghai Municipal Education Commission within fifteen days of its service (Student Appeals Regulations, effective 1 September 2017). A teacher's request to redo or supplement an assessment is not automatically a disciplinary decision.

additionalTopics.summary: 根据复旦大学官方发布公告（AI3A 平台上的指引全文未作独立审核），《生成式人工智能教育教学应用指引 1.0 版》明确 AI 可用于语言润色、结构建议等辅助环节，但不得替代研究构思、理论构建、数据分析等核心学术劳动；判定依据侧重如实披露与可追溯过程记录。该教学指引不改变本科毕业论文关于严禁使用 AI 撰写、润色与翻译正文等更严格规定。
additionalTopics.scope: AI3A 平台上线与《生成式人工智能教育教学应用指引 1.0 版》官方发布公告（2026年1月13日；AI3A 平台全文未作独立审核；不取代本科毕业论文禁止规定）。

claims.text: On 12 January 2026 Fudan launched the AI3A education co-creation platform and published the Generative AI Education and Teaching Application Guide 1.0, with 11 annexes such as an AI use declaration template and reference syllabus clauses. According to Fudan's official announcement, the guide allows AI for supporting steps such as language polishing and structural suggestions but not to replace core academic work such as research conception, theory building and data analysis, and judges integrity mainly on honest disclosure and process records. The guide's full text sits on the AI3A platform and was not independently reviewed; it is teaching guidance and does not by itself override the stricter undergraduate-thesis rule.
